categories.main_business_segments: JM Holdings operates primarily in the supermarket business, with a focus on fresh foods such as meat, produce, seafood, and prepared foods. The group also engages in other businesses including restaurant operations (notably yakiniku and tonkatsu chains), food-related event planning, supermarket outsourcing (register operations), and shopping center management. The main supermarket brands are 'Japan Meat Seisenkan', 'Japan Meat Wholesale Market', 'Power Mart', 'MEAT Meet', 'Niku no Hanamasa', and 'Super Miraberu'.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages large-scale, efficient meat processing at its logistics centers, combined with in-store processing capabilities to ensure freshness and rapid response to demand. It employs a 'single-item bulk sales' strategy, regularly conducting high-volume promotions. The group has established robust procurement and inventory systems, including large-scale storage and logistics centers, and maintains ISO9001-certified quality management systems across its facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JM Holdings serves a broad customer base, including general consumers (especially families and local residents) and professional buyers such as restaurant operators, particularly through its 'Niku no Hanamasa' urban wholesale stores. Its supermarkets are positioned both in suburban and urban areas, catering to both everyday shoppers and business customers seeking bulk purchases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the Kanto region (including Tokyo and surrounding prefectures), with a growing presence in urban Tokyo (23 wards), northern Tokyo, and recent expansion into the Kansai area (notably Osaka). All operations and assets are located within Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: JM Holdings is positioned downstream in the supply chain as a retailer, but also integrates midstream functions through its in-house meat processing, logistics, and procurement centers. It manages both direct-to-consumer retail and business-to-business wholesale channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include aggressive new store openings (8-10 per year), expansion into new geographic areas (notably Kansai), development of private brand and directly imported products, and active consideration of M&A. The company emphasizes internalization of manufacturing and processing, supply chain resilience, and ESG/CSR initiatives such as food safety, environmental sustainability, and diversity in human resources. There is no mention of traditional R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of food and daily goods at supermarkets and restaurants. Additional income streams include event management, outsourcing services (register operations), and facility management. The company also receives management fees and rental income from group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JM Holdings competes with other large supermarket chains and food retailers in Japan, as well as specialty and wholesale food stores. Its unique positioning comes from its origins as a meat specialist, its urban wholesale format ('Niku no Hanamasa'), and its integration of procurement, processing, and retail. Major competitors are not explicitly named, but include national supermarket chains and regional players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending July 2025, consolidated net sales reached 186.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 10.0 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 6.5 billion yen. The company has shown consistent growth, with sales increasing by 8.1% and net profit by 18.2% year-on-year. The medium-term plan targets sales of 250 billion yen and operating profit of 15 billion yen by July 2029.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JM Holdings differentiates itself through its expertise in fresh meat, large-scale and efficient in-house processing, and the ability to offer high-quality, safe, and affordable products. Its 'single-item bulk sales' promotions, urban wholesale store format, and strong supply chain integration enable both competitive pricing and product freshness. The company emphasizes customer satisfaction, enjoyable shopping environments, and professional service as key value drivers.
